fields.label: Group Label
fields.description: Shown to the customer, e.g. Pick 1 Bread

fields.label: Customer Picks
fields.description: How many option units the customer must choose from this group

fields.label: Allow Repeats
fields.description: When unchecked, each option may be picked at most once from this group (pick-many-distinct). When checked, the same option may be picked multiple times, capped by that option's Max Per Option (pick-many-any).

fields.label: Group Key
fields.description: Auto-generated identifier that links options to this group
